exit-code.text:
# aws-cli for the link comparison (#747): the shared config file
# (AWS_CONFIG_FILE). At the `defaults` cell nothing below changes a transfer
# setting: max_concurrent_requests (10), multipart_threshold (8MB),
# multipart_chunksize (8MB) and the retry mode stay the shipped ones
# (https://awscli.amazonaws.com/v2/documentation/api/latest/topic/s3-config.html).
# run.py appends an `s3 =` block for equal-conns and tuned cells; the values are
# in the row's `settings` column.
# telemetry: none to turn off. aws-cli v2 sends no usage reporting; the only
# client identification is the User-Agent header every SDK sends.
[default]
# region: the lab MinIO ignores it; SigV4 needs one
# (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-files.html).
region = us-east-1
# s3.addressing_style path: MinIO serves path-style buckets
# (https://awscli.amazonaws.com/v2/documentation/api/latest/topic/s3-config.html).
s3 =
  addressing_style = path

size-and-checksum.text:
# rclone for the link comparison (#747): `rclone copy /data/files lab:<bucket>/<prefix>`.
# At the `defaults` cell the transfer flags are rclone's shipped ones:
# --transfers 4, --s3-upload-concurrency 4, --s3-chunk-size 5Mi,
# --s3-upload-cutoff 200Mi (https://rclone.org/s3/ and https://rclone.org/docs/).
# run.py adds the flags of equal-conns and tuned cells; the values are in the
# row's `settings` column. rclone checks size and checksum after each upload
# by default (https://rclone.org/s3/#avoiding-head-requests-to-read-the-modification-time),
# which is its profile `size-and-checksum`.
# telemetry: none to turn off. rclone sends no usage reporting.
[lab]
# type/provider: the S3 backend, MinIO flavour (https://rclone.org/s3/#minio).
type = s3
provider = Minio
# env_auth false: the keys come from RCLONE_CONFIG_LAB_ACCESS_KEY_ID and
# RCLONE_CONFIG_LAB_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (https://rclone.org/docs/#config-file).
env_auth = false
# endpoint: through the middlebox, as every tool dials it.
endpoint = http://netem:9200
region = us-east-1

exit-code.text:
# s5cmd for the link comparison (#747). s5cmd has no config file: this is its
# command line, one argument per line, '#' lines ignored. At the `defaults`
# cell the transfer flags are s5cmd's shipped ones: --numworkers 256,
# cp --concurrency 5, cp --part-size 50 (MiB)
# (https://github.com/peak/s5cmd/blob/v2.3.0/README.md#configuring-concurrency).
# run.py adds the flags of equal-conns and tuned cells; the values are in the
# row's `settings` column.
# telemetry: none to turn off. s5cmd sends no usage reporting.
# --endpoint-url: through the middlebox, as every tool dials it.
--endpoint-url=http://netem:9200

strong.text:
# VTOP for the link comparison (#747). run.py fills the @...@ fields; the
# committed text (placeholders included) is what config_sha256 hashes, and the
# filled values are in the row's `settings` column and the run's logs.
# Every key is in docs/configure/reference.md (the section named per key).
# telemetry: none to turn off. VTOP sends no usage reporting; OpenTelemetry
# export is off unless configured (docs/operate/monitoring.md), and it is not.
engine:
  name: link-compare
  tenant: default
  # engine.state_store / work_dir: the per-run tmpfs at /state (fresh every run).
  state_store: "sqlite:///state/vtop.db"
  work_dir: /state/work
  # engine.log_level: info, so each committed batch logs a batch_metrics line
  # run.sh counts to know the upload is done.
  log_level: info
batching:
  # batching.max_records 1 and max_bytes above one file: one file, one batch,
  # one object, as #483 shaped the workload (workload shape, not tuning).
  max_records: 1
  max_bytes: @MAX_BYTES@
  # batching.max_batch_age_seconds: never the seal reason (one record seals).
  max_batch_age_seconds: 3600
@CONCURRENCY@compression:
  # compression.type none: the files are incompressible, so the object is the
  # payload and nothing confounds the wire bytes (#747 "Workload").
  type: none
checksum:
  # checksum.algorithm sha256 (the shipped default): verification is derived
  # from the stored content or a store-computed digest (profile `strong`).
  algorithm: sha256
sources:
  file:
    enabled: true
    # sources.file.whole_file: each file is one record, read as stored.
    whole_file: true
    paths:
      - "/data/files/*.bin"
upload:
  # upload.backend s3_native, through the middlebox (netem:9200), plaintext lab.
  backend: s3_native
  bucket: "@BUCKET@"
  prefix: "@PREFIX@"
  endpoint_url: http://netem:9200
  region: us-east-1
  force_path_style: true
  verify_tls: false
  # upload.create_bucket false: the harness creates the bucket, for every tool.
  create_bucket: false
  # upload.require_strong_verification: the shipped default, stated.
  require_strong_verification: true
@TRANSPORTS@
